scripts.build: mkdir -p public/assets && cp index.html yacht.html booking.html vendor.html admin.html login.html payment-return.html public/ && cp -R assets/. public/assets/
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.check: npm run types && npx tsc && npm run build && npm run check:assets && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run && wrangler check startup --env staging
